L5·N3397unmasked layer
Fires on the preposition immediately following a passive/past-participle verb (seized **from**, edited **from**, made **to**, developed **at**, Made **with**), and is strongly suppressed when that preposition is "by" (viewed by, called by) — i.e. it tracks which preposition fills the post-participle slot.
